deals.postCaption: 8 THINGS TO DO IN VIENNA IN AUGUST ☀️🇦🇹 🍷 NEUSTIFTER KIRTAG A traditional Austrian folk festival that takes place from August 21 to August 24. Put on your dirndl or lederhose and head to Neustift am Walde, a Vienna wine-growing area, for a street lined with Heurigen and a fun evening with music, wine and Austrian food. 🎬 FILMFESTIVAL RATHAUSPLATZ Until August 31 the Rathausplatz transforms into a huge outdoor food court where you can taste yourself through various cuisines. On a giant screen in front of the City Hall you can watch opera performances, musicals, classical concerts or pop concerts for free. 👙 KRAPFENWALDBAD One of my favorite pools in Vienna. Surrounded by forest, with amazing views over the city. I love going in the morning when it’s less crowded. 🍹 DONAUKANAL A great spot for an evening walk. Lots of restaurants and bars, I love having dinner at Neni am Wasser. 🎭 THEATER IM PARK An open-air stage in a beautiful garden near Belvedere. Comedy, cabaret, concerts , there’s something for every taste. 🎡 PRATER Rent a bike, go for a walk, have a picnic in the green part of the Prater or enjoy the fun rides at the Wurstelprater. Always a good idea on a summer day. ☕️ CAFÉ GARDENS One of my favorite things, sitting outside in the morning when it’s still a bit cooler. Breakfast just tastes better in the fresh air. I love Treu am Platzl, Ulrich, or Melangerie among many others. You’ll find more of my café tips in my summer article on my blog or here on Instagram. 🌅 DAY TRIP TO RUST Just an hour from Vienna, this pretty town on Lake Neusiedl is perfect for a summer day.
